fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Shown as the post heading and used to build the page address.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: The teaser shown on the blog list and in Google results. Two or three sentences.

fields.name: pubDate
fields.label: Publication Date
fields.description: Sets the page address (/YYYY/MM/DD/...). Changing it on a published post changes its address and breaks existing links.

fields.name: updatedDate
fields.label: Updated Date
fields.description: Optional. Shown at the foot of the post as "Last updated".

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Banner image
fields.description: Wide banner at the top of the post and on the blog list. Around 670x241.

fields.name: categories
fields.label: Categories
fields.description: Broad topic, one or two. Type to add. Reuse an existing name where you can: General, SSW Projects, AI, Family, FireBootCamp, Scrum, .NET, SSW Rules, Training, NDC Sydney, Angular, .NET Core

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Specific subjects, as many as apply. Type to add. Existing tags include: AI, github, year in review, SSW TV, TinaCMS, CMS, NDC Sydney, .NET, ChatGPT, china, Copilot, Coronavirus

fields.name: body
fields.label: Post
fields.description: Use the + button for images, videos and YouTube embeds. Captions follow the house style: "Figure: what the image shows".

fields.name: videoId
fields.label: YouTube video ID
fields.description: The 11-character ID from a YouTube URL (e.g. dQw4w9WgXcQ)

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Optional caption shown under the video. House style is "Figure: ...".

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Describes the image for screen readers and when it fails to load.

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Shown under the image. House style is "Figure: ...".

fields.name: src
fields.label: Video file
fields.description: Path to an mp4/mov under /media.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Items (JSON)
fields.description: Legacy WordPress galleries only. Leave alone unless you know the JSON format.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The heading shown at the top of the page.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: Meta Title (SEO)
fields.description: Shown in the browser tab and search results, not on the page itself. Falls back to the Title above.

fields.name: legacyUrl
fields.label: Original WordPress URL
fields.description: Path this page had on WordPress. Kept so permalink drift is detectable.

fields.name: videoId
fields.label: YouTube video ID
fields.description: The 11-character ID from a YouTube URL (e.g. dQw4w9WgXcQ)

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Optional caption shown under the video. House style is "Figure: ...".

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Describes the image for screen readers and when it fails to load.

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Shown under the image. House style is "Figure: ...".

fields.name: src
fields.label: Video file
fields.description: Path to an mp4/mov under /media.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Items (JSON)
fields.description: Legacy WordPress galleries only. Leave alone unless you know the JSON format.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Site Identity & SEO
fields.description: Site-wide identity. These values appear on every page — the Site Name is shown in the header navigation and used as the default browser title; the Description is the default for search results and social shares.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: Shown in the header navigation on every page. Lives in Global Config because it's the same site-wide — each page sets its own browser title via the Meta Title field on the page, and this Site Name is used as the fallback if a page is ever missing one.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Default Meta Description (SEO)
fields.description: Default description shown in search results and social-sharing previews when a page does not provide its own.

fields.name: siteOwner
fields.label: Site Owner (shown in footer)
fields.description: Your name or company name. Displayed in the site footer.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Shown next to the Site Name in the header navigation.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation Menu
fields.description: Links shown in the header navigation. Reorder, add, or remove items below. The Site Name shown to the left of these links is set in Site Identity & SEO above.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Link Label
fields.description: The text shown in the nav for this link.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: Where this nav item points (e.g. /about or https://example.com).

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Any Tabler icon name, e.g. tabler:brand-x, tabler:book-2, tabler:brand-github. Browse at https://icones.js.org/collection/tabler

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
